verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents official client SDKs for Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP, and Ruby. Each SDK offers idiomatic interfaces, type safety, and built-in streaming, retries, and error handling, and the official `ant` CLI complements them. Versioning guarantees on the Messages API support stable building against them. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, per-SDK depth (coverage of agent features like tool use, batches, and MCP in each language), and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found all paths 404).
